DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she agreed to the private supervised rewrite, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants the rewrite date, the new mark in before December 1, and your written confirmation tonight; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time never ran out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before the call, then gave her dated documents she could check, and when she tried a defence you answered it with something she could verify herself, so each piece stood.
What cost ground: Nothing; you never led with the detector score, never called Owen a liar, and never offered a better mark for her silence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with the title at 11:31 PM and the text arriving at 11:52 and 11:58 PM the night before the essay was due, came very close to that night, which is why she went short and hard on procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Once she agreed to the rewrite, put a specific date before December 1 on the table yourself instead of leaving it for the email.
